value.rationale: With a fixed amount of removed order information and prescribed level sizes, the result determines the exact minimum and exact second possible nonalgebraic type count, with complete and attainable equality classes for all feasible k. It explains a structural effect of dependent missing incidences via positive association and biclique correction, and the perfect-matching standard example yields an exponential separation from the complete two-level order. These are natural model-theoretic extremal questions, not an arbitrary table slice.
